accepted.s: Under the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS), the central assistance is payable at which of the following rates?
o: ₹300 per month for 60–79 years and ₹500 per month for 80 years and above
₹500 per month for 60–79 years and ₹1,000 per month for 80 years and above
₹100 per month for 60–79 years and ₹200 per month for 80 years and above
₹200 per month for 60–79 years and ₹500 per month for 80 years and above
accepted.x: IGNOAPS provides ₹200 per month to persons aged 60–79 years and ₹500 per month to those aged 80 years and above. It is meant for elderly persons belonging to BPL households.
accepted.tq: Split the age groups and match each with its corresponding amount.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS):
1. It is implemented under the National Social Assistance Programme.
2. The Ministry of Rural Development is the concerned ministry.
3. It is meant for elderly persons belonging to BPL households.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. IGNOAPS is an NSAP component administered under the Ministry of Rural Development for BPL elderly persons.
accepted.tq: Use the ministry, programme and beneficiary linkage to identify the complete combination.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana was launched on 1 April 2017 at which place?
accepted.x: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana was launched at Nellore in Andhra Pradesh on 1 April 2017.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely related locations within the same State.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT provided as a free physical aid under the Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana?
accepted.x: The scheme provides aids such as walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids and dentures to BPL senior citizens. Motorised agricultural pumps are not covered.
accepted.tq: Find the option that does not belong to the same beneficiary-support group.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana is implemented through which combination?
accepted.x: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana is associated with the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment and ALIMCO.
accepted.tq: Identify the implementing agency by separating the ministry from the delivery corporation.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana:
1. It is funded from the Senior Citizens’ Welfare Fund.
2. At least 30 per cent beneficiaries in each district are required to be women.
3. It is intended for BPL senior citizens.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The scheme is funded from the Senior Citizens’ Welfare Fund, targets BPL senior citizens and requires at least 30 per cent women beneficiaries in each district.
accepted.tq: Check whether the beneficiary, funding and gender-target details all belong to the same scheme.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY) is best described as:
o: A single pension scheme for government employees
An umbrella programme comprising four elderly-care initiatives
A food-grain distribution programme for widows only
A contributory insurance scheme for workers above 60 years
accepted.x: AVYAY is an umbrella programme comprising the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens, State Action Plan, Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana and Elder Line.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an umbrella programme from an individual pension or insurance scheme.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the components of Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana?
accepted.x: The four components of AVYAY are the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens, State Action Plan, Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana and Elder Line. The National Family Benefit Scheme is an NSAP component.
accepted.tq: Use the programme-family distinction to reject an NSAP component.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana, which of the following combinations is correct?
o: 10% assured pension for 10 years; maximum purchase price ₹7.5 lakh; maximum pension ₹10,000 per month
8% assured pension for 5 years; maximum purchase price ₹10 lakh; maximum pension ₹7,500 per month
8% assured pension for 10 years; maximum purchase price ₹7.5 lakh; maximum pension ₹5,000 per month
7% assured pension for 15 years; maximum purchase price ₹5 lakh; maximum pension ₹3,000 per month
accepted.x: PMVVY offered an assured pension at 8 per cent for 10 years, with a maximum purchase price of ₹7.5 lakh and maximum pension of ₹5,000 per month.
accepted.tq: Match the three numerical limits without confusing duration, purchase price and pension ceiling.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding PMVVY is correct?
o: It is administered by MoSJE through ALIMCO and is funded by the Senior Citizens’ Welfare Fund.
It is administered by MoRD through India Post and is available only to BPL persons.
It is administered by MoHFW through the National Health Authority and provides medical insurance.
It is administered by the Ministry of Finance through LIC and is GST-exempt.
accepted.x: PMVVY is associated with the Ministry of Finance and LIC, and the scheme is GST-exempt. It is a pension product rather than a medical-insurance scheme.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who would administer this product?’ method to separate pension, welfare and health schemes.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: PMVVY was closed for new subscriptions after:
accepted.x: New subscriptions under PMVVY were closed after 31 March 2023.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely spaced closing dates.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Senior Citizen Savings Scheme primarily provides:
o: Free medical devices to BPL elderly persons
Equity funding for elderly self-help groups
Food grains to destitute elderly persons
Safe fixed-interest savings for senior citizens
accepted.x: The Senior Citizen Savings Scheme, available through India Post and banks, provides a safe fixed-interest savings avenue for senior citizens.
accepted.tq: Match the financial product with its core benefit rather than with welfare or health benefits.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Integrated Programme for Senior Citizens (IPOP):
1. It may provide up to 90 per cent of project cost to eligible NGOs.
2. It supports old-age homes, day-care centres and mobile medicare units.
3. It is a component of AVYAY.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: IPOP can support up to 90 per cent of project cost for NGOs and covers old-age homes, day-care centres and mobile medicare units. It is included under AVYAY.
accepted.tq: Verify the funding, service and programme-hierarchy statements together.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the SAGE innovation associated with AVYAY, the maximum equity support is:
o: ₹25 lakh, with government stake below 25 per cent
₹1 crore, with government stake below 49 per cent
₹5 crore, with government stake below 51 per cent
₹50 lakh, with government stake below 49 per cent
accepted.x: SAGE, or Seniorcare Ageing Growth Engine, provides equity support up to ₹1 crore, with government stake kept below 49 per cent.
accepted.tq: Read the amount and ownership ceiling as two separate numerical clues.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following initiatives is associated with the promotion of the silver economy under AVYAY?
accepted.x: SAGE promotes innovations and enterprises in the senior-care sector and supports the silver economy. AGRASR is another AVYAY-related initiative involving elderly self-help groups.
accepted.tq: Separate innovation and enterprise initiatives from NSAP assistance components.
accepted.sec: Elderly schemes → benefit and launch place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007, the obligation to maintain parents extends to:
o: Only biological sons above 18 years of age
Biological, adopted and step-children, and legal heirs in the relevant circumstances
accepted.x: The Act places obligations on biological, adopted and step-children, and also on legal heirs in relation to senior citizens who cannot maintain themselves.
accepted.tq: Watch for the restrictive word ‘only’ in the options on legal obligation.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In Andhra Pradesh, the Maintenance Tribunal under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 is headed at the sub-divisional level by the:
accepted.x: In Andhra Pradesh, the Maintenance Tribunal functions at the sub-division level and is headed by the Revenue Divisional Officer or Sub-Collector.
accepted.tq: Use the level of the tribunal to identify the appropriate administrative authority.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the appellate mechanism under the Act in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Appellate Tribunal is at State level and headed by the Governor.
The Appellate Tribunal is at sub-division level and headed by the RDO.
The Appellate Tribunal is at district level and headed by the District Collector.
The Appellate Tribunal is at national level and headed by the Union Minister.
accepted.x: The Appellate Tribunal is constituted at the district level in Andhra Pradesh and is headed by the District Collector.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the maintenance tribunal from the appellate tribunal by level and authority.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The maximum monthly maintenance prescribed under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 is:
accepted.x: The Act prescribed a maximum maintenance amount of ₹10,000 per month.
accepted.tq: Test the statutory ceiling directly using nearby monetary distractors.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: A case before a Maintenance Tribunal under the Act should ordinarily be disposed of within:
accepted.x: The prescribed time limit for disposal of a case is 90 days.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the statutory time limit from shorter procedural periods.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: A transfer of property made subject to the transferee providing basic amenities and physical needs to a senior citizen may be declared void under:
accepted.x: Section 23 permits a transfer of property to be declared void where the transferee neglects the senior citizen despite the condition of care attached to the transfer.
accepted.tq: Match the specific statutory section with the legal consequence.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Section 20 of the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 deals with:
accepted.x: Section 20 concerns the provision of medical care for senior citizens and forms the basis of the National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly.
accepted.tq: Use section-number matching and reject provisions belonging to Sections 23 or other parts of the Act.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007:
1. At least one old-age home is contemplated in every district.
2. Abandoning a senior citizen may attract imprisonment up to three months and/or a fine up to ₹5,000.
3. The Act is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Act provides for old-age homes, penalises abandonment and is administered by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
accepted.tq: Combine institutional, penal and administrative provisions without confusing them with pension schemes.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following was proposed by the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens (Amendment) Bill, 2019?
o: Transfer of all tribunal powers to local police stations
Removal of the ₹10,000 maintenance cap and expansion of ‘children’ to include sons-in-law, daughters-in-law and grandchildren
Limiting maintenance obligations to biological sons
accepted.x: The 2019 Bill proposed removing the ₹10,000 cap and widening the definition of children to include sons-in-law, daughters-in-law and grandchildren. The Bill lapsed.
accepted.tq: Identify the amendment proposal while rejecting changes that reverse the original welfare obligation.
accepted.sec: Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act 2007 - obligations, tribunals, cap, appeals, homes, 2019 bill  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following groups is covered under the NTR Bharosa Pension scheme in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Only persons with disabilities below 18 years
Elderly persons, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen and artisans
Only elderly persons and government pensioners
Only farmers affected by crop loss
accepted.x: NTR Bharosa Pension provides monthly assistance to elderly persons, widows, single women, weavers, fishermen and artisans, among others.
accepted.tq: Select the option containing the complete beneficiary group rather than a single category.
accepted.sec: State old-age pension schemes → state; AP pensions  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about pensions in Andhra Pradesh:
1. NTR Bharosa Pension succeeded YSR Pension Kanuka.
2. Pension distribution is automated with Aadhaar-based biometric verification.
3. Andhra Pradesh supplements NSAP pensions from its own funds.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Andhra Pradesh renamed the scheme as NTR Bharosa Pension, uses Aadhaar-based biometric verification and adds State funds to central NSAP assistance.
accepted.tq: Check the scheme’s succession, delivery mechanism and funding source together.
accepted.sec: State old-age pension schemes → state; AP pensions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What is the old-age pension eligibility age in Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: The old-age pension eligibility age in Andhra Pradesh is 60 years.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the State eligibility age from age thresholds used in other social-security components.
accepted.sec: State old-age pension schemes → state; AP pensions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The old-age pension in Andhra Pradesh was raised to ₹4,000 in 2024 from the earlier amount of:
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh pension was raised to ₹4,000 in 2024; the earlier amount under YSR Pension Kanuka was ₹3,000.
accepted.tq: Compare the current amount with the immediately preceding State-scheme amount.
accepted.sec: State old-age pension schemes → state; AP pensions  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) was launched in:
accepted.x: NSAP was launched in 1995 under the Ministry of Rural Development as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.
accepted.tq: Use the chronology of early social-assistance initiatives to identify the launch year.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: NSAP was launched to give effect to which Article of the Constitution?
accepted.x: NSAP was launched to give effect to Article 41, which relates to public assistance in cases including old age, sickness and disablement.
accepted.tq: Match the social-assistance programme with its constitutional directive.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: IGNWPS — BPL elderly persons aged 60 years and above
National Family Benefit Scheme — death of the breadwinner
Annapurna — contributory pension for government employees
accepted.x: The National Family Benefit Scheme provides assistance in the event of the death of the breadwinner. IGNWPS concerns widows, IGNDPS concerns persons with severe disabilities, and Annapurna provides food grains to needy elderly persons.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive breadwinner-death pair and eliminate the swapped targets.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under IGNWPS, the beneficiary group and assistance are:
o: BPL elderly persons aged 60–79 years; ₹200, rising to ₹500 at 80 years and above
Needy elderly persons; food grains instead of cash assistance
Persons aged 18–79 years with 80 per cent disability; ₹300
Widows aged 40–79 years; ₹300, rising to ₹500 at 80 years and above
accepted.x: IGNWPS covers widows aged 40–79 years and provides ₹300, with the amount rising to ₹500 for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above.
accepted.tq: Separate the widow, elderly and disability categories before matching the amount.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: The Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) covers persons aged:
o: 40–79 years with 80 per cent or more disability
18–79 years with 80 per cent or more disability
21–60 years with 60 per cent or more disability
14–59 years with 40 per cent or more disability
accepted.x: IGNDPS covers persons aged 18–79 years having 80 per cent or more disability and provides ₹300 assistance.
accepted.tq: Match both the age range and disability threshold; either one alone is insufficient.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: Annapurna, an NSAP component, provides:
o: Food grains to needy elderly persons
Medical insurance to all persons above 70 years
Assistive devices to BPL senior citizens
A pension to widows aged 40–79 years
accepted.x: Annapurna provides food grains to needy elderly persons. The other options describe benefits under different schemes.
accepted.tq: Distinguish in-kind food assistance from cash pension, health cover and assistive-device schemes.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which State enacted the first law making maintenance of parents mandatory in 1996?
accepted.x: Himachal Pradesh enacted the first such State law in 1996, making maintenance of parents mandatory.
accepted.tq: Separate the first State law from the later central legislation and State pension schemes.
accepted.sec: Social assistance and early laws - NSAP, first state law  [other exams]

accepted.s: Under the National Policy on Older Persons, 1999, an ‘older person’ is one who is:
accepted.x: The National Policy on Older Persons, 1999 defines an older person as an individual aged 60 years or above.
accepted.tq: Identify the policy definition rather than using a general retirement-age assumption.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT among the principal areas of intervention identified under the National Policy on Older Persons, 1999?
o: Compulsory military service for older persons
accepted.x: The policy includes health care, nutrition, self-provision, family care, NGO support and geriatric training among its 14 principal areas. Compulsory military service is not one of them.
accepted.tq: Reject the option that is unrelated to the policy’s welfare and care orientation.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s: Which of the following is a distinctive focus of the National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011?
o: Ageing in place and special attention to elderly women
Exclusion of rural elderly persons from policy coverage
Replacement of all family care by institutional care
accepted.x: The 2011 policy responds to the growing elderly population and rural destitution, with emphasis on elderly women, ageing in place, income security, homecare and health insurance.
accepted.tq: Identify the positive welfare focus and reject absolute formulations such as ‘all’ and ‘exclusion’.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011:
1. It envisages harsh punishment for elder abuse.
2. It gives importance to income security, homecare and health insurance.
3. It focuses on ageing in place.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements reflect the focus of the National Policy for Senior Citizens, 2011.
accepted.tq: Recognise the complete policy package instead of selecting only one welfare objective.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s: The highest advisory body on elderly policy in India is the:
accepted.x: The National Council for Senior Citizens is the highest advisory body on elderly policy.
accepted.tq: Identify the body by its specific advisory role rather than by a general rights mandate.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s: The National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly (NPHCE) was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in:
accepted.x: NPHCE was launched by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in 2010–11.
accepted.tq: Match the programme with its ministry and launch period.
accepted.sec: National Policy on Older Persons 1999 and National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011

accepted.s: Elder Line 14567 is:
o: A national helpline for senior citizens and a component of AVYAY
A legal-aid helpline exclusively for women
A medical-insurance registration number for children
accepted.x: Elder Line 14567 is the National Helpline for Senior Citizens and forms part of AVYAY.
accepted.tq: Use the number and programme association together to identify the helpline.
accepted.sec: Elderly helpline - Elder Line

accepted.s: Which organisation provides technical support to Elder Line along with State emergency response centres?
accepted.x: Elder Line is run by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment with State emergency response centres and technical support from Tata Trusts and NSE Foundation.
accepted.tq: Match the helpline’s technical-support partners rather than its administering ministry.
accepted.sec: Elderly helpline - Elder Line

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Elder Line:
1. It operates under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
2. Its helpline number is 14567.
3. It is limited to pension disbursement and does not provide broader senior-citizen support.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because Elder Line is a National Helpline for Senior Citizens and is not limited merely to pension disbursement.
accepted.tq: Find the negative overstatement that narrows a broad public-service helpline to one function.
accepted.sec: Elderly helpline - Elder Line
